invariants.rationale: Every possible value of b is covered; only included for completeness, but not recommended as a meaningful invariant.
Dividing any integer a by 1 yields a; this relates to valid division scenarios when b == 1.
When b is 1 or -1, division is exact. Also, the method checks for division by zero, so those cases are handled.
The parameter a must be within the valid int range by Java's type system.
The parameter b must be within the valid int range by Java's type system.
